title: Microsoft Teams panels: hide the organiser name in Calendar View

claims.where: controls notes; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Managing device settings in the Pro Management portal requires Rooms Management RBAC permissions.
claims.quote: you can configure settings for Microsoft Teams devices (Teams Rooms on Windows, Teams Rooms on Android, Teams Panels and Teams Phones), provided you have the necessary role-based access control permissions for Rooms Management.

claims.claim: A device setting changed through the portal is applied through a settings job.
claims.quote: Since setting changes from the Teams Rooms Pro management portal to the Teams device aren't in real-time, there will be a delay. An indicator is visible next to any setting that is pending a change or pending verification of a change as a visual cue that a job is in progress for that device.

claims.claim: Apply Now queues a job to apply the setting.
claims.quote: Apply Now - Queues a job to apply the setting and restarts the device as soon as possible to apply the setting changes.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Apply Now restarts the device as soon as possible.
claims.quote: Apply Now - Queues a job to apply the setting and restarts the device as soon as possible to apply the setting changes.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Schedule Later applies the settings change during the nightly maintenance window.
claims.quote: Schedule Later - Schedules the settings change to be applied during the nightly maintenance window to avoid disrupting scheduled meetings during business hours.

claims.claim: A settings job can fail with DEVICE IN MEETING.
claims.quote: | Failed | DEVICE IN MEETING | Device is currently in a meeting. | Try again later. |

claims.claim: A settings job can fail because the device is disconnected.
claims.quote: | Failed | DEVICE DISCONNECTED | Device was disconnected when we attempted to execute the settings change, so no changes occurred. | Reapply the settings change. |

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Portal settings management is available only for signed-in devices.
claims.quote: Settings management is available only for signed-in devices. Ensure that the device is signed in for settings changes from the Teams Rooms Pro management portal to be applied successfully.

claims.claim: Settings changed directly on the device are synchronised back to the portal.
claims.quote: Any setting changes made directly on the device are synchronized back to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal and reflected in the Settings tab of the device panel, providing visibility into the device's current configuration.

claims.claim: The documented entry path for per-device settings is Teams Rooms Pro Management portal > Rooms/ Phones > device > Settings.
claims.quote: Go to Rooms/ Phones in the left navigation and click the device you want to configure. Select the Settings tab in the device panel.

claims.claim: No PowerShell, Microsoft Graph or other API for Show organizer name is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/teams "panel" "organizer"; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph Teams panels device settings jobs organizer name; "Teams panels" "organizer" "PowerShell" "Graph". Read release notes, portal settings and Teams PowerShell search excerpts; no matching API.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents settings categories but not the category containing Show organizer name.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams panels "Show organizer name" "Settings" licensing price; "Show organizer name" "Teams" "Meetings". Opened Learn rooms/pro-portal-settings, rooms/device-settings-available and devices/devices-release-notes; no category for this setting.

claims.claim: The portal supports changing settings on an individual panel device.
claims.quote: you can configure settings for Microsoft Teams devices (Teams Rooms on Windows, Teams Rooms on Android, Teams Panels and Teams Phones) ... You can change settings on a single device

claims.claim: The general bulk-job path is Teams Rooms Pro Management portal > Settings > Device Settings > Jobs.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal, go to Settings > Device Settings. Select the Jobs tab.

claims.claim: No API equivalent for the device-settings bulk job control is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro device settings jobs API PowerShell Microsoft Graph panels configuration; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph Teams panels device settings jobs organizer name. Opened Learn rooms/pro-portal-settings and read returned excerpts; no bulk settings-job API documented.

claims.claim: Device setting jobs provide a general control for applying device settings to multiple panels.
claims.quote: you can configure settings for Microsoft Teams devices (Teams Rooms on Windows, Teams Rooms on Android, Teams Panels and Teams Phones) ... You can change settings on a single device, or for many devices at once using Device setting jobs.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly confirmed Show organizer name as a setting supported by bulk jobs.
